title: Pokemon TCG Japanese Nidoran 151 032/165 Reverse Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and highly sought-after Nidoran 032/165 Pokémon card is a must-have for any serious collector or fan of the game. Featuring the iconic character Nidoran (♂), this card is made from high-quality card stock and has a stunning reverse holo finish that is sure to impress.

With its Japanese language and intricate artwork by Shinji Kanda, this card is a true work of art that is sure to stand the test of time. Whether you are a seasoned collector or just starting out, this card is a great addition to any collection and is sure to delight. Don't miss your chance to own this rare and amazing Nidoran card!
